about_the_game: Experience the suspense, romance, and intrigue of Phantom of the Twilight through 16 beautifully composed tracks. From eerie melodies echoing through the foggy streets of London to tender themes of love and devotion, this soundtrack captures the essence of the game's gothic storytelling. Whether unraveling the mystery once more or simply enjoying the rich, atmospheric compositions, this collection is an essential companion to your journey.
